parameters.description: The ID of the project to inspect.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: A limit on the number of spend alerts to return. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Sort order for the returned spend alerts.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the ID of the last spend alert from the previous response to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the ID of the first spend alert from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
parameters.name: before

ProjectSpendAlertListResource.description: Paginated list of project spend alerts.

data.description: Spend alerts returned in the current page.

first_id.description: The ID of the first spend alert in this page.

has_more.description: Whether more spend alerts are available when paginating.

last_id.description: The ID of the last spend alert in this page.

ProjectSpendAlert.description: Represents a spend alert configured at the project level.

currency.description: The currency for the threshold amount.

id.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

interval.description: The time interval for evaluating spend against the threshold.

object.description: The object type, which is always `project.spend_alert`.

threshold_amount.description: The alert threshold amount, in cents.

SpendAlertNotificationChannel.description: Email notification settings for a spend alert.

recipients.description: Email addresses that receive the spend alert notification.

subject_prefix.description: Optional subject prefix for alert emails.

type.description: The notification channel type. Currently only `email` is supported.
